name: explain-error
description: Diagnose an error message or stack trace and propose the safest fix first.
steps: classify the error (build, runtime, network, permission)
recall past fixes from memory and check known issues
propose fixes ordered safest-first with the risky ones flagged
validation: at least one fix includes a verification command
failure_recovery: state what is unknown and what extra log line would help
cautions: diagnosis only: never apply fixes automatically
never suggest disabling security (firewalls, permissions) as a fix
